item.title: Suspect among 3 killed in Seattle shooting; teen arrested, 3rd suspect sought
item.description: Police believe a suspect in the deadly shooting at a food festival in Seattle was among those who were killed, as another suspect remains on the loose and a teenager is in custody.

item.title: "The Odyssey" movie sparking renewed interest in original book
item.description: Moviegoers are turning out in droves for the IMAX spectacle "The Odyssey," but they're also flocking to something else: the 2,700-year-old source material. Matt Gutman has more.

item.title: Biden tapes released after legal battle, with references to classified material
item.description: Audio recordings that former President Joe Biden fought for years to keep private have now been released.

item.title: Search continues for American mom missing in Grenada
item.description: On the Caribbean island of Grenada there is an increasingly desperate search for Elizabeth Waddell, a 44-year old North Carolina mom who's been missing for five days. Cristian Benavides reports.

item.title: U.S. mom and kids trapped by French wildfire: "Such an unstable situation"
item.description: A mother from Tennessee slept through wildfire evacuation operations in southwest France, and now she's trapped with her kids as the blaze threatens the city Bordeaux.

item.title: Biden recordings with ghostwriter released over his objections
item.description: Roughly 70 hours of recordings of an interview former President Joe Biden did with a ghostwriter in 2017, before he was president, were released Monday over Biden's objections. Weijia Jiang reports.

item.title: European wildfires could burn for months, officials say, as evacuations continue
item.description: Deadly wildfires continue to rampage across parts of Spain and France, stranding tourists and forcing hundreds of thousands to evacuate. Officials say the fires could continue to burn for months. Imtiaz Tyab reports.

item.title: Entries from Dr. Anthony Fauci's diary released
item.description: Diary entries by Dr. Anthony Fauci are shedding light on his soaring notoriety during the COVID-19 epidemic. The documents, released by Republican Sen. Rand Paul, include Fauci's reflections about being invited to A-list parties, but also some uncertainty about the origin of COVID.

item.title: The biggest weather risk for homeowners? It's no longer hurricanes.
item.description: Severe "convective" storms account for roughly a third of global natural disaster economic losses, a new study finds.

item.title: Ex-husband testifies in trial for mom accused of murdering her kids
item.description: The trial for Lindsay Clancy, the woman accused of murdering her three small children, began Monday with her ex-husband taking the stand. Shanelle Kaul reports.

item.title: Manhunt underway for suspect in Seattle food festival shooting as new details about incident emerge
item.description: A manhunt is underway in Seattle for a suspect after police say a possible dispute turned into a mass shooting Sunday. It happened at a summer food festival near the iconic Space Needle. Three people were killed and a toddler was among the injured. Carter Evans has the latest.

item.title: Pair of lifeguards keep young swimmer from being swept out to sea in California
item.description: A pair of lifeguards stood their ground against ferocious waves to keep a young swimmer from being swept out to sea amid dangerous rip currents that affected parts of the California coast over the weekend. Jericka Ducan has the story.

item.title: Extremely dangerous tornado tears through Wisconsin in wild day of severe weather
item.description: A dangerous tornado barreled through Wisconsin on Monday as a severe weather system impacted more than 100 million people. CBS News' Ian Lee and Rob Marciano have more.

item.title: Berlin Pride attack suspect had been released from prison despite ISIS ties
item.description: CBS News has learned that the 21-year-old man accused of plowing his vehicle through Berlin's Pride celebration on Saturday night had previously received a suspended sentence for charges related to his attempt to join ISIS. CBS News foreign correspondent Chris Livesay has the latest from Berlin.

item.title: Inside Germany's deradicalization programs as Berlin Pride attack suspect identified
item.description: Bill Braniff, executive director of the Polarization and Extremism Research and Innovation Lab at American University, joins "The Daily Report" to break down the attack that took place at an LGBTQ+ pride event in Berlin, Germany and new details on the suspect's time in a deradicalization program.

item.title: Ohio governor calls Trump's plan to deport Haitians "a mistake"
item.description: Camilo Montoya-Galvez sits down with Ohio Governor Mike DeWine to discuss the Trump administration's plan to arrest and deport thousands of Haitians residing in the U.S. under temporary protected status.

item.title: Democratic and Republican strategists on turmoil inside the DNC
item.description: Democratic National Committee Chair Ken Martin is short on cash, and according to The New York Times, short on composure. Political strategists Joel Payne and Jesse Arm join to react to the allegation that Martin threw a phone at a staffer and to unpack the DNC's finances.

item.title: Trump threatens more strikes on Iran if new talks stall
item.description: President Trump threatened to resume strikes on Iran if his current attempt at diplomacy fails, despite some concerns within the administration over the United States' declining military stockpile. Eleanor Watson reports.

item.title: Trump visits Michigan in pre-midterm push
item.description: President Trump visited the battleground state of Michigan on Monday with less than 100 days to go till the midterm elections. Olivia Rinaldi reports.

item.title: Police say at least 3 suspects involved in Seattle shooting; 1 at large, 1 in custody, 1 dead
item.description: Court documents say at least three suspects were involved in Sunday's shooting at a Seattle food festival. One suspect is in custody, another is at large, and the police believe one died at the scene. CBS News correspondent Carter Evans has the latest.

item.title: Ohio's GOP governor calls Trump's plans to deport Haitians a "mistake"
item.description: Republican Ohio Gov. Mike DeWine told CBS News the Trump administration's plan to ramp up deportations of Haitian migrants is a "mistake," arguing the move could bruise Ohio's economy.

item.title: Taylor Farms CEO pressed by lawmaker over cyclospora outbreak
item.description: Rep. Robert Garcia is seeking information about whether Taylor Farms used White House ties to influence the federal response to the foodborne illness outbreak.

item.title: Races to watch with 99 days until midterms
item.description: Monday marks 99 days until the midterm elections. All 435 House seats are up for grabs, along with 35 Senate seats. CBS News executive director of elections and surveys Anthony Salvanto and Sabato's Crystal Ball managing editor Kyle Kondik join with analysis.

item.title: Sen. Ron Johnson on released Fauci diary entries
item.description: Ahead of Anthony Fauci's Senate testimony on Wednesday about the federal response to the COVID-19 pandemic, Kentucky GOP Sen. Rand Paul released thousands of entries from the diary of the former director of the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases. Republican Sen. Ron Johnson of Wisconsin, who sits on the committee that will question Fauci, joins with his reaction.

item.title: ICE to ramp up deportations of Haitian migrants, sources say
item.description: Sources tell CBS News that ICE is ramping up operations to arrest and deport Haitian migrants and to terminate their legal status in the United States. CBS News immigration correspondent Camilo Montoya-Galvez has the details from Springfield, Ohio.

item.title: Chiefs assistant coach Eric Bieniemy's son charged in shooting of his mother
item.description: The son of Chiefs assistant coach Eric Bieniemy has been arrested and charged with a shooting that wounded his mother, Mia Bieniemy, according to authorities in Virginia.

item.title: Georgia man who ran toward Capitol with shotgun pleads guilty
item.description: Prosecutors say Carter Camacho of Smyrna, Georgia, told police officers who apprehended him outside the Capitol that he intended to confront members of Congress and "scare them into speaking the truth."

item.title: Search ongoing for 2nd suspect in deadly Seattle shooting
item.description: Authorities in Seattle are still searching for a second suspect in connection with Sunday's deadly food festival shooting. A 15-year-old is in custody. CBS News' Anna Schecter has the latest.

item.title: Bryan Kohberger challenges conviction in Idaho murders
item.description: Bryan Kohberger​, the man serving multiple life sentences for the murders of four University of Idaho students​, filed a petition for post-conviction relief Monday.

item.title: Amazon plans to deploy more than 5,000 satellites for new telecom service
item.description: Amazon Leo wants to launch a constellation of thousands of satellites to connect devices directly from space.
